items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...and Edith Wilson. I listened to her all the time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I'm trying to think who I was listening to that -- oh, Viola McCoy. I've always listened to her songs, Viola McCoy. And I tried to make comparisons between Bessie -- not Bessie, but who's this girl? Always tried to make a comparison between -- not Viola McCoy -- yeah, Viola McCoy and some other girl was singing the blues at that time. But I never listened to them to copy from them, because I couldn't copy anything from anybody. I've always been individual. Had my own way.

I can't remember now who it was, but I know Viola McCoy was one of them -- and Nina Wilson -- and Edith Wilson. I listened to her all the time. Edith Wilson, Nina Wilson, and there was somebody else's record that I used to listen to. Never trying to copy, just enjoying them, you know.
